data: Apple delivered a solid fiscal 2025, with revenue rising 6.4% to $416.2 billion from $391.0 billion in fiscal 2024. Profitability improved more sharply: net income grew 19.5% to $112.0 billion in fiscal 2025, up from $93.7 billion in fiscal 2024, so earnings growth well outpaced the top line. The balance sheet also strengthened. Total liabilities fell to $285.5 billion in fiscal 2025 from $308.0 billion in fiscal 2024, while total assets eased only modestly to $359.2 billion from $365.0 billion. Cash and cash equivalents rose to $35.9 billion in fiscal 2025 from $29.9 billion a year earlier. The one soft spot is cash generation, as operating cash flow slipped to $111.5 billion in fiscal 2025 from $118.3 billion in fiscal 2024. Investors should watch whether that trend reverses.
